title: My Daughter Faked Terminal Cancer And Stole My $140K. So I Recorded Her Confession.
description: Grace Williams' daughter faked a terminal illness to drain her entire retirement fund. Grace recorded the confession, took her to court, and now the daughter scrubs toilets at Maternal Mercy motel, where every room key prints the fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #Karma
pinned_comment: If your own daughter faked a terminal illness to steal your entire $140,000 retirement, would you have pressed charges or made her work it off? Share your story in the comments.
